ducknng browser wasm demo

This page loads the ducknng DuckDB extension in duckdb-wasm, runs the browser smoke checks, and then exposes a small SQL shell against the same connection. The current browser proof is intentionally narrow: extension load, codec and registry calls, raw inproc:// URL-launched AIO bytes, and framed RPC manifest collection over inproc:// under the pthread runtime.

Browser ipc://, raw tcp://, native POSIX-style tls+tcp://, HTTP, and WebSocket transports are not proven by this page.

Setup and smoke tests

The threaded runtime needs cross-origin isolation. On GitHub Pages this page installs a same-origin service worker and reloads once to add COOP/COEP headers.
